note: Fighting NPCs can now chase you around buildings instead of getting stuck on the wall. A retaliating townsfolk or guard follows a real path — the same pathfinder their daily walks use, with road preference and building avoidance — and replans at most about once every second and a half while you move, so there is no performance cost like the old pathfinding lag. If you get somewhere truly unreachable, they wait a few seconds and then give up and go back to their day instead of swinging at a wall forever. Hit speed, damage, and XP are unchanged
